title: Home renovation ahead of the EPC deadline

messages.whisper: The renovation clock for this home is running and the energy bill keeps rising. Nothing is shared with partners.
messages.forming: The heating system is reaching the end of its life. Are you planning to renovate?
messages.ready: A boiler repair points to work starting now. Here is a plan across partners for you to approve step by step.

candidates.why: An up-to-date EPC certificate shows where the home stands against the renovation target.
A cost and grant estimate shows what each renovation step costs now that grants have changed.
Insulation lowers the heat the home needs, so it comes before the heating system is sized.
The boiler is at the end of its life and a heat pump can replace it once the home is insulated.
candidates.title: Heat pump installation

candidates.why: Panels cover part of the electricity a heat pump will use.
A group round gives a better price on the energy contract than a standard offer.
A loan sized against the expected savings spreads the cost of the renovation.
The insured value and cover change once the home is renovated.
Not needed yet. A battery only pays back once solar panels produce more than the home uses during the day.

messages.whisper: Energy costs are rising faster than revenue. Nothing is shared with partners.
messages.forming: The Brussels low-emission zone now reaches your delivery vans. Are you planning to replace them?
messages.ready: A deposit on an electric van points to a decision now. Here is a plan across partners for you to approve step by step.

candidates.why: A view of emissions and a comparison with similar bakeries shows where energy cost comes from.
Advice on the ovens and the building comes before any investment.
Roof panels lower the daytime power cost and part of the charging cost.
Charging at the bakery lets the new van charge overnight.
candidates.title: Business charging with Blink Charging

candidates.why: Asset financing spreads the cost of replacing the vans.
A group round lowers the price of electricity and gas for the premises.
Not needed at this size. An ESG report matters for larger companies and their reporting duties.
